title: Fire Technical Council Council Order No. 0015449: storage areas, clearances and site hazards at a pallet recycling facility
jurisdiction: Alberta (order issued by an accredited municipality; the municipality is not named in the decision text)
code_edition: Alberta Fire Code 2006 (stated on p.1 and p.6)
document_date: 2015-07-13 (dated; Chair signature block; hearing 2015-06-22; order dated 2015-01-29)

facts.text: The accredited municipality issued an order dated 29 January 2015 against a pallet recycling facility. The appeal was heard on 22 June 2015.

The order's listed requirements (quoted after 'FROM:') were storage-area sizes and clearances conforming to Table 3.3.3.2 of AFC 2006, with a compliance date of 1 May 2015, and a clear space of at least 30 m between stored products and brush or forested areas.
The Council ordered that the Order is VARIED. The varied terms are set out in the lettered findings (a)-(m), not in one consolidated list.

The panel stated that a parcel with partial tree coverage would not constitute a forest, and found that the area bordering two lots is better defined as 'uncontrolled grass or weeds' under AFC 3.3.2.3(2).
The panel found the storage area exceeds 6,000 m2 on the evidence, which requires access from a public thoroughfare.
The panel found the Respondent's demand for spill-control provisions for waste oils and dangerous goods appropriate, given wrecked vehicles on site.
The panel found that the property owner is responsible under AFC 3.3.2.8 for smoking and ignition sources, and that enforcement against any violation is for the Respondent.
The panel recorded the Act's variance power: a written variance may be issued where it provides approximately equivalent or greater safety performance.
The decision is dated 13 July 2015 and carries a Chair signature block for the Fire Technical Council Appeal Panel.
